text.en:
Upon finishing a reload while within 15 metres of allies:
Overflows Magazine by 10% for each ally, up to a 50% Magazine Increase.
text.zh-chs:
15 米范围内每有一名盟友：
填装时会过量填充 10% 的弹匣，最高 50%。

Maxes out at 50% Increased Magazine Capacity.

text.en:
Finishing a reload overfills the Magazine from reserves by 10% of the Base Magazine Capacity (rounded up) for each ally within 15 meters.

Overfill amount maxes out at 50%.

While within 15 meters of allies:
• Finishing a reload overfills the Magazine from reserves by 10% of the Base Magazine Capacity (rounded up) for each ally. Maximum of a 50% overfill.
• Swords receive increased Charge Rate
• Bows receive decreased Draw Time

While within 15 meters of allies:
• Finishing a reload overfills the Magazine from reserves by 10% of the Base Magazine Capacity (rounded up) for each ally
• Swords receive increased Charge Rate
• Bows receive decreased Draw Time
